fomod.Name: TFCam
fomod.Author: StinkyPumpkin (original), CageTV (fork)
fomod.Description: A free camera overhaul for Skyrim SE / AE / VR (SKSE plugin, no ESP): camera roll, an attached camera light, time freeze, FOV control, screenshot keys, a cell-entry camera, the Scene Camera, the idle / furniture camera, and the Camera Path tool with image effects and a video recorder. The installer picks the TFCam.dll that matches your game version. Needs SKSE, the Address Library for SKSE Plugins and SKSE Menu Framework; PrismaUI (optional) gives the Camera Path its editor bar.
